title: A secret.key wallet from someone else shows funds you cannot send

summary.text: Daedalus can import a wallet from a secret.key file made by an old version of Daedalus. A secret.key file that someone else gives or sells you is a known scam. The imported wallet shows a balance, but the file does not hold the key that can spend it, so every payment from it is rejected.

problem.text: A wallet imported from a secret.key file that someone else provided shows a balance, but every payment from it is rejected.

symptoms.text: A wallet imported from a secret.key file shows a balance and transaction history, but sending from it fails.
Someone offers to sell a secret.key file for a wallet with a large balance.

user_phrases.text: I bought a secret.key file but cannot send the ada

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.2 tag source and its English interface text, for the mainnet release, and from the cardano-wallet revision that 11.6.2 pins (f293d922f193). Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The file does not hold the key that the wallet's addresses were made from. The wallet still finds those addresses and shows their balance, but it signs only with a key that reproduces an address, so a payment from them carries no valid signature and the network rejects it.

resolutions.action: Check where the secret.key file came from. Only a file that you made yourself with an old version of Daedalus holds your own wallet's keys.
resolutions.why: Daedalus imports secret.key files from Daedalus 0.15.1 and earlier.

resolutions.action: If someone else gave, sold or sent you the file, stop trying to send from the wallet.
resolutions.why: The file cannot spend those funds, so every attempt is rejected.

expected_outcome.text: You pay nothing for a wallet whose funds the file cannot spend.

do_not: Do not pay for a secret.key file, or for help to unlock one.
Do not send ada to anyone who says it is needed to release the funds.

evidence.rationale: Community reports in the repository issue identify the circulated file and the requests for payment. The mechanism is read from the cardano-wallet revision that Daedalus 11.6.2 pins (f293d922f193) and from the 11.6.2 tag source. Source inspection, not runtime testing.
